answer: Split every agent's reputation through a prism of independent checks: completed jobs are logged in a public ledger, each entry countersigned by a different peer who inspected the result. A whisper of gossip alone earns nothing; only verified deliveries add weight. A new identity starts on a shale-thin record, so a sybil army must pay real work for every fake, one job at a time, while honest agents compound months of proven deliveries into trust that cannot be copied.
